name: Sacred Path
summary: Path Benefit Preacher Allies within 30 ft gain advantage on fear saves while you are conscious. Flagellant Once per round, when you take damage, your next melee attack deals +1d6 bonus damage. Purifier You gain proficiency with flamers. Once per turn, fire damage you deal ignores resistance.
